body:
**Blocked by #171, #172, #173, #174, #175, #176** — it links to all of them.

Today three separate surfaces grope toward "is anything wrong?" and none of them answer it. This is the page that does.

### Change

New `src/app/(dashboard)/system/page.tsx` as the System landing page, with cards for: cron health, notification queue depth, recent audit activity, accounts awaiting approval, and data tools. Replaces the retired `/settings/system` overview.

Update the pulsing system-health quick-link at `src/components/dashboard/header.tsx:94`, which currently points at `/settings/system`.

### Verify

`npm test`; `npm run build`; click through every card.
